value.rationale: A source-designed rank-efficiency mechanism suffers a nonvanishing, tunable probability of retaining an unnecessary rank on a family where best rank one already satisfies tolerance and the current residual indicator is exactly zero. The result quantitatively disentangles bad basis orientation from residual estimator noise, and exhibits a no-new-operator-query singular-value rotation remedy. It is a meaningful sharp diagnostic of an explicitly published numerical rank-pruning strategy, not merely a renamed elementary distribution.
